kept.title: Incorrect global replacement of '%' placeholder in hook function
kept.explanation: The change replaces a global regular expression replacement for '%' with a single string replacement. The original code replaced all '%' characters globally, but the new code replaces only the first occurrence. This change could cause problems if the script command string contains multiple '%' placeholders, as only one will be replaced with the ordered package names instead of all.
kept.suggestion: Change the replacement back to using a global regex to replace all '%' characters: use new RegExp('%', 'g') as the first argument to mout.string.replace.
kept.failureAfterChange: If config.scripts[action] contains more than one '%' character, only the first '%' is replaced with the package list, resulting in incorrect command strings being run and possibly failing scripts.

verdicts.reason: The finding correctly identifies that the change replaced a global replacement of '%' with a single replacement, causing only the first '%' character to be replaced. The code after change only replaces the first occurrence, which is a concrete defect if the script string contains multiple '%' placeholders, leading to incorrect script commands being run. This is a valid, concrete defect introduced by the change.
